visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler girl with short dark hair sits in a grey stroller indoors, wearing a green floral-patterned shirt and light blue shorts; she touches her hair while looking around with a curious expression. The setting is a large indoor hall with a blue ceiling featuring grid patterns and white walls. Subtitles in Traditional Chinese appear at the bottom. (2) A wide shot shows a large crowd of visitors walking through a spacious aquarium corridor; the lighting is blue, and visitors are mostly seen from behind. The ceiling has decorative blue panels and mounted security cameras. Chinese subtitles continue to describe the busy environment. (3) The toddler is seen in a close-up reaction shot; her face is illuminated by a soft glow in a darkened room as she looks upward with her mouth slightly open in amazement. Behind her, a massive aquarium tank is filled with hundreds of small silver fish swimming in a dense school. (4) Inside a darkened viewing area, visitors hold up smartphones to record a synchronized light show inside the main tank; schools of sardines move rhythmically as blue light beams project patterns through the water. The toddler claps her hands excitedly while watching the fish and rays swim by. (5) Transitioning to an outdoor stadium, a dolphin leaps high out of the water against a blue wall; a trainer in a black wetsuit stands on a white platform feeding another dolphin. The setting is a large stadium pool with tiered seating visible in the distance. (6) A large walrus with long white tusks crawls onto the pool's platform, guided by a trainer wearing a colorful tropical shirt; the walrus claps its flippers together as the audience watches. The toddler is shown clapping along while seated with her mother. (7) White beluga whales perform in the pool with three trainers swimming alongside them; they move in circular patterns, creating splashes. The stadium background features large video screens. The video ends with a pink graphic featuring a cartoon girl and brand text.
